masked_recolor_contract.nodes: LoopCoreLoadMesh imports the single untransformed native SaveGLB checkpoint; MaskedReferenceMeshColors preserves its vertex positions/face indices and replaces COLOR_0 only. All loaders are staged current, hash checked inputs; geometry_file is a forbidden path patch.
masked_recolor_contract.inputs: geometry GLB checkpoint; isolated RGB image; SAM3 foreground_mask image aligned to isolated. Mask white=foreground, black=background, threshold>.8. Source RGB min<.65 excludes white antialias contamination. Bounds come from mask; nearest valid masked source RGB samples projected gaps.
masked_recolor_contract.projection: Native GLB Y-up; X horizontal, Y vertical, remaining Z depth. u=(X cos(angle)-Z sin(angle)-min)/span, v=1-(Y-min)/span, then map into mask bbox. Default angle0, flip_horizontal false. Uses one actual reference view for all surface vertices, avoiding cross-view silhouette mismatch. Perspective/hidden colors are approximation; no manual color stripes or shape replacement.
masked_recolor_contract.patches: node4 horizontal_axis,vertical_axis,view_angle,mask_threshold,white_threshold,flip_horizontal are strategy inputs. Node1 geometry_file cannot be patched.
